svg.title: From Equipment Package to Broker Paycheck
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-finance-broker-deal-funnel; chapter number: 6; title: From Equipment Package to Broker Paycheck; subtitle: Source behind the seller, match the file to a lender; chart type: funnel; stages: label: Heavy iron package sourced through a vendor; value: 350000; display: $350,000; conversion: Sourced via equipment vendors, CPAs, and bankers; detail: Caterpillar excavator package for an excavation contractor.; label: First-deal excavator financed; value: 180000; display: $180,000; conversion: Closed in 60 days; detail: Michael Chen, a student with zero finance background, arranged financing without lending his own money.; label: Credit-app-only ceiling; value: 75000; display: Up to $75,000; conversion: Above it, request the last three years of tax returns or audited financials; detail: Signed proposal plus one monthly payment as a performance deposit before any credit app goes to a lender.; label: Broker spread on the $350,000 package; value: 17500; display: $14,000 to $17,500; conversion: Standard 4% to 5% broker spread; detail: One approval on the excavator package.; label: First-deal commission; value: 4200; display: $4,200; conversion: Academy range of $2,000 to $5,000 per funded deal; detail: Earned on the $180,000 excavator.; caption: Commission claims run wide, from $2,000 to $5,000 per funded deal up to Jermane Cheathem's claim of 20 points on a $100,000 deal.; assumptions note: Stages mix two separate practitioner examples ($350,000 and $180,000 excavators) plus the credit-app ceiling; they are not one tracked deal. Application-only ceilings reported from $75,000 to $350,000; credit floors from 580 to 650.; note: Sources - Equipment Finance Academy, Buzz Glover (BizLoanConsultants.com), and Jermane Cheathem.
